news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a pre-NDA meeting with the FDA and received constructive feedback that aligned on the planned content, format, and strategy of its obefazimod NDA submission for ulcerative colitis. The company confirmed it remains on track to submit the NDA in late Q4 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on Abivax shares to $180 from $132, joining other banks in upgrading estimates following the strong ABTECT maintenance dataset and the company's improved cash position.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders (marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access) drawn from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie, Eli Lilly and Abbott, with experience on brands like Entyvio and Humira. The hires bolster the company's build-out of a US commercial organization ahead of its planned Q4 2026 NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: In a CNBC interview, Abivax's CEO said the company's newly raised $920 million cash cushion gives it the option to independently commercialize obefazimod in the US rather than seeking a buyout partner. This followed persistent takeover speculation involving large pharma suitors.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an oversubscribed public offering of American Depositary Shares priced at $125 each, upsized from an initial $600 million target to $920 million in gross proceeds after full exercise of the underwriters' option. Net proceeds of roughly $874 million are earmarked for US commercialization of obefazimod and extend the company's cash runway into Q2 2029.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod, Demonstrating Meaningful Clinical Benefit in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data in a more refractory UC population showed 37.2% clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at week 44 among induction non-responders treated with 50mg obefazimod, with dose escalation recapturing remission in about 45% of relapsing patients. The data further strengthened the drug's safety database and eased prior investor concerns about malignancy signals, sending shares up roughly 36-38%.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA in late Q4 2026, having received positive alignment from the FDA in a pre-NDA meeting on submission content and format.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results and provide a pipeline/cash-runway update.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA submission for obefazimod in UC
catalysts.detail: Abivax intends to file a Marketing Authorization Application with the European Medicines Agency in the second half of 2026, supported by the positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance results.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction data in Crohn's disease
catalysts.detail: Topline induction-phase results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderately to severely active Crohn's disease are expected, which would open a second major indication.

catalysts.label: FDA approval decision / potential US launch
catalysts.detail: Following the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing, a standard FDA review cycle would put a potential approval decision and commercial launch of obefazimod in the US in 2027, for which Abivax is already building its commercial organization.

pulse: As of August 3, 2026, Abivax remains in a strong post-catalyst window: positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data (including in refractory patients) resolved earlier safety concerns and triggered a roughly 35-40% stock surge, an oversubscribed $920 million ADS offering extended cash runway into Q2 2029, and a subsequent positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA keeps the company on track to file its first NDA in late Q4 2026. Management is now explicitly building out an independent US commercial organization rather than relying on a buyout, even as takeover speculation (including earlier Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca interest) continues to circulate in the market, and sell-side analysts (Jefferies, BTIG, Morgan Stanley, Truist) have sharply raised price targets. Near-term watch items are the September 21, 2026 H1 results, a planned H2 2026 EMA MAA filing, and late-2026 Crohn's disease (ENHANCE-CD) induction data as the next major catalyst after UC.
